company.name: Freenome
company.shortDescription: Freenome is a biotechnology company developing blood tests for early cancer detection to improve access to routine screening.
company.description: Freenome is a private biotech company that focuses on developing blood tests for early cancer detection, aiming to make screening accessible to everyone. The company aims to empower individuals in cancer prevention, detection, and treatment through innovative, non-invasive testing solutions. The company is at the forefront of non-invasive disease screening, which could transform how cancers and other diseases are proactively managed.
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, California, United States

aiResearchSummary.text: Freenome is researching blood based cancer screening by combining transcription factor profiling, nucleic acid methylation analysis, and TCR BCR profiling for cell free nucleic acid detection of cancer. Markers for the early detection of colon cell proliferative disorders and RNA markers and methods for identifying colon cell proliferative disorders support colorectal screening. Methods and systems for risk stratification of colorectal cancer refine population level assessment across these areas.
